phoenix_chronicles.task_type.kill_entity:
Kill a number of a specific mob type.
Target: entity registry id (e.g. minecraft:zombie)
Have a specific item in your inventory.
Target: item registry id. Consume: remove items on complete.
If AE2 is installed, also counts items stored in your linked ME network (toggle: check_ae2_storage).
Craft a specific item the required number of times.
Target: item registry id.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.recipe.tool:
Run a recipe a number of times - any recipe of a type (every macerator recipe), or one specific recipe.
Target: recipe type id (e.g. gtceu:macerator).
Secondary: a specific recipe id (optional).
Count: how many runs. Counted for the machine's owner, or the nearest player.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.gt_multiblo:
Form a GregTech multiblock. Counted for the machine's owner, or the nearest player if nobody owns it.
Target: controller block id (e.g. gtceu:electric_blast_furnace), or * for any multiblock.
Count: how many times.
Reach a minimum XP level.
No target needed. Just set the required level.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.location_te:
Interact with a specific terminal block or location.
Target: terminal registry id.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.advancement:
Earn a specific Minecraft advancement.
Target: advancement id (e.g. minecraft:story/mine_diamond)
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.block_inter:
Place or right-click a specific block, optionally several times.
Target: block id. Secondary: PLACE or RIGHT_CLICK. Count: how many times.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.fluid_check:
Have a fluid amount in a tank.
Target: fluid id. Count: amount in mB.
If AE2 is installed, also counts fluid stored in your linked ME network (toggle: check_ae2_storage).
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.stat.label: Stat Tracker
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.stat.toolti:
Reach a value on a Minecraft statistic.
Target: stat id (e.g. minecraft:jump). Count: target value.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.dimension.t:
Travel to a specific dimension.
Secondary: dimension id (e.g. minecraft:the_nether)
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.biome.label: Visit Biome
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.biome.toolt:
Stand inside a specific biome.
Target: biome registry id (e.g. minecraft:jungle)
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.structure.t:
Enter a specific structure.
Target: structure registry id (e.g. minecraft:village)
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.checkmark.t:
Admin-completable manual task.
No target needed: complete with /chronicle task complete.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.tag_item.to:
Have items matching an item tag in inventory.
Target: item tag (e.g. c:ores/iron). Count: required amount.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.info.label: Info / Text
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.info.toolti:
A read-only information panel the player must acknowledge.
No target: body text is shown to the player.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.timer.label: Timer
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.timer.toolt:
Completes automatically once the configured duration has elapsed since the quest became active for the player.
No target needed: set Duration (seconds).
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.energy_chec:
Check stored energy (FE or GTM EU) in inventory items OR a right-clicked block.
Count: amount required.
Target: FE / EU / ANY  (energy type).
Secondary: INVENTORY / HELD / BLOCK  (source).
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.filter_item:
Have items matching a composable filter in inventory.
Filter types: exact, tag, mod, any_of, all_of, not.
Consume: remove matching items on completion.
Example: any_of [ {tag: forge:ingots/copper}, {tag: forge:ingots/gold} ]
If AE2 is installed, also counts matching items stored in your linked ME network (toggle: check_ae2_storage).
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.filter_flui:
Have a fluid amount in inventory matching a composable filter.
Filter types: exact, tag, mod, any_of, all_of, not.
Supports fluid tags (e.g. forge:milk, minecraft:water).
Amount in mB. Consume: drain fluid on completion.
If AE2 is installed, also counts matching fluid stored in your linked ME network (toggle: check_ae2_storage).
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.block_break:
Break a specific block a required number of times.
Target: block registry id (e.g. minecraft:stone). Count: how many times.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.enchantment:
Complete when the player has a specific enchantment at >= the required level on any item the player carries or wears (enchanted books count).
enchantment_id: registry id (e.g. minecraft:sharpness). required_level: minimum enchantment level.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.view_machin:
Completes when the player views a Phantasia build guide for a specific machine for at least the required time.
Target: machine id (Phantasia multiblock definition id).
Completes when the player views a multi-machine Phantasia scene for at least the required time.
Target: scene id (Phantasia scene definition id).
Completes when the player opens a Phantasia build/lore guide.
Target: guide id (Phantasia guide definition id). No minimum time - Phantasia doesn't report when guides close.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.archive_ent:
Completes when the player views a Phoenix Archive lore entry.
Target: entry id (e.g. phoenix_archive:log_001) - the id shown/set in Archive's own editor. No minimum time.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.external_tr:
Completes when an external mod/script fires QuestAPI.fireExternalEvent() with the matching trigger ID.
Target: trigger id (e.g. mymod:sun_eaten).
Count: how many times the event must fire.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.conflux_res:
Completes when the player's Conflux research team has unlocked a specific research node or flag.
No effect if PhoenixCore isn't loaded.
phoenix_chronicles.task_type.screen_open: Completes when the player opens this quest's external screen (set via the quest's "External Screen ID" field).
